positions.name: AsyncRememberContract
positions.frame: how does the async remember contract operate — what immediate-return and retrieval guarantees does it establish?
positions.why: All three expressions share a settled, ratified stance describing the async remember contract's operational mechanics: immediate receipt return, polling-based extraction watching, no blocking calls, no lost work on dropped receipts, and two retrieval paths (polling the run or piggybacking the reaction on a later call). A conviction gradient runs through the set — src-1 and src-3 carry decision-level ratification ('We ratified', 'Key decision') while src-2 asserts operational guarantees as a flat claim — but both read in the same direction: what the contract does and why it is safe. The frame holds that tension without resolving it.
